name: Weather
reason: Folks, this week's setup is a mixed bag: early August warmth is there, but a 25.4C average high and 21 mm of rain keep the water from locking into the hot, calm pattern blooms love.
evidence: Average max temp of 25.4C is below the 30C threshold that favours blooms
Only 1 hot day this week, so no sustained heat run
21.0 mm of rain total can mix and flush the water column
Early August timing keeps seasonal bloom potential from being negligible
